title: 第十一章 神经反应速度
content_zh:
“老江似乎很有信心啊。”总教官‘邬通’笑着，可目光依旧落在罗峰身上，在场几乎所有人都看着罗峰，等待罗峰的考核成绩。
罗峰站在拳靶前，脚部猛然发力，身体微微一转腰胯部便迸发出强大力道，瞬间节节贯串，传入手臂。只见罗峰的拳头仿佛是满月劲弓中射出的箭矢，带着一抹残影，“蓬”的一声，拳头就已经砸在了拳靶上。
一拳打出，罗峰眼中已经略有一丝喜色：“出拳感觉好爽，劲道都打出去了。”目光朝显示屏幕一看――“1101kg”
“好。”
“不错。”当即在场的武者有不少就立即夸赞起来。
总教官‘邬通’摸了摸下巴，点头道：“小伙子不错，出拳都谨记不能丢**体重心，如果他不顾一切只求打出最重的拳头，丢**体重心。可能一拳威力更强。可是那样，和怪兽厮杀丢**体重心，就是自杀！不错，不错。”
“哈哈，罗峰这小家伙，实战能力可是很强的。”教官‘江年’哈哈一笑，“他可是曾连击败三个力量、速度上不比他差的高级学员，打的干脆利落啊！”
听着总教官和教官的夸赞，罗峰心中一阵畅快。
少年时代，自己就昏迷过两次，身体力量、速度大增。自那时候开始，自己就定下计划，一定要成为厉害的武者！而厉害的武者，在实战能力上要求是很高的。少年时代，虽然没加入极限武馆，可是从网络上搜索一些刀法基础、身法基础等，一个人在家练习慢慢积累经验。
这也是自己实战强的原因。
“是个好苗子。嗯，通过！”总教官邬通随意又取了一身份证，在仪器上滑过，“下一个，白阳。”
罗峰走回接受考核人群所呆的地方。
“不错啊，疯子。”杨武低声惊讶笑道。
罗峰咧嘴一笑。
八人很快就接受完‘拳力测试’，这八人中只有一人倒霉，一拳只有892kg，离合格线只是差一点所以被淘汰。下一关进行速度测试的，也只剩下七个人。
“卡！”总教官邬通来到速度测试仪旁，
“一个个来，顺序和刚才相反，第一个，杨武。”总教官邬通吩咐道，之前杨武是最后一个测试拳力，这次测试速度倒是第一个。
杨武深吸一口气。
他来这进行准武者考核也近十次了，次次都在速度测试上跌跟头。
“杨哥，加油。”罗峰轻轻在杨武肩膀上拍了拍。

“看着吧。”杨武调整一下呼吸，就走到了跑道上。
教官江年皱着眉看着这一幕，杨武也是宜安区的，可是杨武已经在‘速度测试’上失败好多次了。
“轰！”
杨武蹬踏在地面上发出低沉的声音，有力的甩臂，强劲的蹬踏，令杨武的速度很快就加速到他的极限，他面色狰狞，额头青筋一突一突的，咬着牙疯狂奔跑着。在从速度测试区域跑过的时候，还发出一声压抑的低吼！
“一定要过啊！”杨武停下来的时候，心中怒吼着。
他忐忑的转头看过去，只见这时候罗峰朝他竖起大拇指，看到这一幕，杨武仿佛一下子到了天堂。
“哈哈，杨武啊，运气不错。竟然过线了。”教官‘江年’也发出爽朗笑声。
杨武连跑去，看向显示屏――‘25.1m/s’。
“呼，好险啊。”杨武自己都笑了，如果状态稍微差一点点，速度就可能达不到25米每秒，那样就要再次失败。
“嗯，过！”总教官邬通也露出笑容，“下一个。”
一个个人员进行测试，上一次测试拳力（力量），罗峰是第二个去测试的。而这一次测试速度，罗峰则是倒数第二个。
很快就到了罗峰。
“罗峰。”总教官邬通喊道。
“疯子，加油啊，咱们可要一起去进行武者实战考核呢。”杨武鼓励说道，罗峰微笑点点头就走到了跑道上，略微调整一下呼吸，原地轻松蹦跳两下，不同于杨武那种纯粹蛮力型，罗峰则是让人感觉到很放松。
一发力，罗峰就好似一头豹子猛然窜出，迅速无比，带着一道劲风直接掠过速度测试区域。肉眼都能看出，罗峰的速度明显要比之前几个人都高出一些。
“感觉还行。”罗峰一转过头，就看到杨武同样竖起大拇指。连总教官邬通，还有教官江年，都难得赞叹点点头。
罗峰自己走过去一看，屏幕上显示着――
“28.6m/s”
“速度很不错，竟然比合格线高这么多。”总教官邬通笑着点点头，“最后一个，童关。”
××××××

接连进行完拳力、速度的测试，其中拳力测试淘汰掉一个，速度测试上淘汰掉两个。只剩下五个人。第三项就是‘神经反应速度考核’。
“随我来。”总教官邬通带领着一群武者，以及剩下的参加考核的五人，来到练武厅连接的‘神经反应测试室’。
这是一间大概一百平方的宽敞房间。
当然和之前数千平方米的超大练武厅相比，这个神经反应测试室明显小很多。只见一座高大的贵重仪器正摆放在地面上，这仪器的最前面，就是好像六管加特林机枪般的一个个射出洞口，不过这洞口可比加特林机枪多的多，足有数十个洞口。
“第一个，童关。”总教官邬通开口说道。
络腮胡子大汉立即走到了这测试机枪口的正前方，一个直径三米六的圈内。
“哒！”开关一
那直径三米六的圆圈边缘，立即朝上方发射出迷蒙的红光，一时间在圆圈内的测试者，就仿佛被迷蒙红色纱帐给围住。
“身体碰触红光，则要扣分。”总教官邬通说完，就走到那神经反应测试机旁，按动了好几个按钮，调整了测试的强度。这强度也分很多级别。
最初等的，是中级学员考核。
而最高等的……那是武者中顶级强者去测试训练的。
“开始！”总教官一按动红色按钮。
“嘟～～嘟～～”神经反应测试机那巨大的炮口开始旋转了起来，炮口中数十个枪口几乎瞬间就迸发出一道道红光，速度有快有慢，连飞行轨迹也根本不平行，错乱的很。迅速的便射入红圈范围内。
只见那名络腮胡子大汉，双眸死死盯着前方，身体迅速的不断前后左右闪动，从一些射出的红色子弹夹缝穿过。
“噗！噗！”接连两下被射中。
不过这些‘子弹’都是橡皮头，威力很小，速度不算快，打在人身上不算疼。
时间一分一秒过去。
络腮胡子大汉拼了命在其中不断闪躲，很快时间就到一分钟了。
“呜～～”总教官邬通按动按钮后，测试机的炮口迅速减速停止旋转，而且其中央屏幕更是浮现出大量数据。
“60秒内，被击中57次，碰触红光三次。未合格，淘汰！”总教官‘邬通’开口道，同时扔出了身份证给那名络腮胡子大汉。

“就差一点点。”这络腮胡子大汉咬着牙，摇摇头走出红色圈子范围。
“下一个，罗峰。”总教官邬通说道。
罗峰和杨武相互击拳一次，而后便直接走入了红圈范围内。
站在红圈内，前面测试机的炮口正对着自己，罗峰深吸一口气，自己在未进入武馆的时候，就在家经常练习身法，这闪躲方面一直是自己的最强项：“在高考之前，我60秒内一般被击中50次到55次。而如今我身体素质提升，反应更快，测试过关更没问题。”
“”总教官邬通说完，按动了红色按钮。
“嘟～～嘟～～”
神经反应测试机的炮口迅速加速，很快旋转到一个极快速度，紧接着炮口中数十个枪口几乎瞬间迸发出一道道红光，一颗颗橡胶子弹立即激射而来。
“嗯？”罗峰双眸死死盯着，脑海中迅速计算着位置，整个人则是仿佛一只灵活的猫，不断得前后左右闪躲，一次次避让开一颗颗橡胶子弹。当然也有一些速度太快实在没办法避让，只能挨上‘一枪’。
罗峰在迅速闪避，而在旁边观看着的武者们则是谈论了起来。
“这小伙子不错，他的反应速度，似乎更加优秀。”
“是很快，身法非常好，基础很扎实。你看，他的双脚就仿佛猫爪子的肉垫，每一次身法转移都不丢失重心，可以瞬间改变方向。这种身法……如果不是天才的话，没十年苦功，是达不到这般坚实基础的。”
在场武者都惊叹起来。
武者的身体素质，是可以修炼提升起来。可是身法、刀法等，都是要靠经验的。不是说身体力量强，这身法就高。
“呜～～”按动按钮后，神经反应测试机旋转减速停止下来，屏幕上则是浮现一大串数字。
“60秒内，被击中28次，未碰触红光。优等！”总教官邬通露出笑容，“不错，罗峰，恭喜你，只要等正式文件下达，你的信息录入公民身份信息中后。你就是一名准武者了！”考核通过，七天内，一般就有正式证书下达，而且记录进公民身份信息中去。
罗峰用力握紧右拳：“终于成功了！”
自己，终于成为准武者了！
“罗峰，8月1号武者实战考核。到时候早晨在极限会馆集合，在教官带领下，和其他准武者一道去人类基地市区外猎杀怪兽！等实战考核通过，你就是一名真正武者了。”教官‘江年’微笑说道。
content_en:
"Lao Jiang seems to be very confident." Chief instructor 'Wu Tong' smiled, but his eyes were still on Luo Feng. Almost everyone present was looking at Luo Feng, waiting for Luo Feng's assessment results.
Luo Feng stood in front of the boxing target, his feet suddenly exerted force, and when his body turned slightly, his waist and hips burst out with powerful force, which instantly connected with each other and passed into his arms. Luo Feng's fist seemed to be an arrow shot from the full moon's bow, with an afterimage, and with a "peng" sound, the fist hit the target.
After punching out, Luo Feng had a hint of joy in his eyes: "Punching feels so good, all the strength is released." He looked at the display screen - "1101kg"
"Okay."
"Not bad." Many warriors present immediately praised him.
The chief instructor, Wu Tong, touched his chin and nodded: "Young man is good. He must remember not to lose his **center of weight when punching. If he is desperate to hit the heaviest punch and lose his **center of weight, his punch may be more powerful. But in that case, losing his **center of weight in a fight with a monster is suicide! Yes, yes."
"Haha, this little guy Luo Feng has very strong actual combat ability." Instructor 'Jiang Nian' laughed, "He has defeated three senior students in a row who are not inferior to him in terms of strength and speed. He did it very neatly!"
Listening to the praise from the chief instructor and instructors, Luo Feng felt happy.
As a boy, he fell into coma twice, and his physical strength and speed increased greatly. From that time on, I made a plan to become a powerful warrior! And powerful warriors have very high requirements in terms of actual combat ability. When I was a teenager, although I didn't join an extreme martial arts gym, I searched for some basic knife skills, body skills, etc. on the Internet, and practiced alone at home to slowly accumulate experience.
This is also the reason why he is strong in actual combat.
"It's a good seedling. Well, passed!" Chief Instructor Wu Tong took another ID card casually and slid it over the instrument, "Next, Bai Yang."
Luo Feng walked back to where the people who were undergoing the assessment were staying.
"Not bad, madman." Yang Wu whispered in surprise and laughed.
Luo Feng grinned.
The eight people quickly completed the 'boxing strength test'. Only one of the eight people was unlucky. One punch only weighed 892kg, which was just shy of the qualifying line, so he was eliminated. There were only seven people left for the speed test in the next level.
"Stuck!" Chief Instructor Wu Tong came to the speed tester and said,
"Come one by one, in the opposite order as before. The first one is Yang Wu." Chief Instructor Wu Tong ordered. Previously, Yang Wu was the last one to test his fist strength, but this time he was the first one to test his speed.
Yang Wu took a deep breath.
He has been here nearly ten times for the quasi-martial arts assessment, and every time he failed in the speed test.
"Brother Yang, come on." Luo Feng gently patted Yang Wu on the shoulder.
"Just watch." Yang Wu adjusted his breathing and walked to the runway.
Instructor Jiang Nian frowned and watched this scene. Yang Wu was also from Yi'an District, but Yang Wu had failed the 'speed test' many times.
"Boom!"
Yang Wu pedaled on the ground and made a deep sound. His powerful arm swings and powerful pedaling quickly accelerated Yang Wu's speed to his limit. His face was ferocious, with veins on his forehead bulging out as he gritted his teeth and ran wildly. When running through the speed test area, he even let out a suppressed roar!
"We must pass!" Yang Wu roared in his heart when he stopped.
He turned around nervously and saw Luo Feng giving him a thumbs up. Seeing this scene, Yang Wu seemed to be in heaven.
"Haha, Yang Wu, you're lucky. He actually crossed the line." Instructor 'Jiang Nian' also laughed heartily.
Yang Wulian ran and looked at the display screen - '25.1m/s'.
"Phew, it's so dangerous." Yang Wu himself laughed. If the condition was a little worse, the speed might not reach 25 meters per second. In that case,To fail again.
"Yes, pass!" Chief Instructor Wu Tong also smiled, "Next one."
Each person was tested one by one. The last time the punching power (strength) was tested, Luo Feng was the second to test. In this speed test, Luo Feng was second to last.
Soon we arrived at Luo Feng.
"Luo Feng." Chief Instructor Wu Tong shouted.
"Madman, come on, we are going to take the warrior's actual combat assessment together." Yang Wu encouraged, Luo Feng smiled and nodded and walked to the track, adjusted his breathing slightly, and jumped twice easily on the spot. Unlike Yang Wu's pure brute strength, Luo Feng made people feel very relaxed.
As soon as he exerted his strength, Luo Feng suddenly jumped out like a leopard, extremely fast, and passed directly through the speed test area with a strong wind. It can be seen with the naked eye that Luo Feng's speed is obviously higher than the previous ones.
"It feels okay." Luo Feng turned his head and saw Yang Wu also giving a thumbs up. Even Chief Instructor Wu Tong and Instructor Jiang Nian rarely nodded in admiration.
Luo Feng walked over and took a look, and the screen displayed -
"28.6m/s"
"The speed is very good, it is much higher than the qualifying line." Chief instructor Wu Tong smiled and nodded, "The last one is Tong Guan."
××××××
Tests on punching strength and speed were carried out one after another. One person was eliminated in the boxing strength test and two were eliminated in the speed test. Only five people remained. The third item is the ‘nervous reaction speed assessment’.
"Follow me." Chief Instructor Wu Tong led a group of warriors, as well as the remaining five people taking the assessment, to the 'nervous response test room' connected to the martial arts training hall.
This is a spacious room of about one hundred square meters.
Of course, compared with the previous super-large martial arts training hall of thousands of square meters, this neural response testing room is obviously much smaller. I saw a tall valuable instrument placed on the ground. At the front of the instrument, holes shot out one by one like six-barreled Gatling guns. However, there were many more holes than Gatling guns, with dozens of holes.
"The first one, Tong Guan." Chief Instructor Wu Tong said.
The bearded man immediately walked to the front of the test machine's gun port, within a circle with a diameter of three meters and six meters.
"Da!" Switch one
The edge of the circle with a diameter of 3.6 meters immediately emitted a misty red light upwards. For a moment, the tester in the circle seemed to be surrounded by a misty red gauze.
"Points will be deducted if the body touches the red light." After the chief instructor Wu Tong finished speaking, he walked to the nerve response testing machine and pressed several buttons to adjust the intensity of the test. There are many levels of intensity.
The first thing to wait for is the intermediate student assessment.
And the most advanced ones... those are tested and trained by the top warriors.
"Start!" The chief instructor pressed the red button.
"Beep~~Beep~~" The huge muzzle of the neural response test machine began to rotate. Dozens of muzzles in the muzzle burst out streams of red light almost instantly. The speed was fast and slow. Even the flight path was not parallel at all and was very confusing. It quickly shot into the red circle.
I saw the bearded man, his eyes fixed on the front, his body rapidly flashing back and forth, passing through the gaps between some fired red bullets.
"Puff! Puff!" He was shot twice in succession.
However, these 'bullets' are all rubber-tipped, have very little power, are not very fast, and do not hurt when they hit people.
Time passed by minute by minute.
The bearded man tried his best to dodge among them, and soon the time was up to one minute.
"Woo~~" After Chief Instructor Wu Tong pressed the button, the muzzle of the test machine quickly decelerated and stopped rotating, and a large amount of data appeared on the central screen.
"In 60 seconds, I was hit 57 times and touched the red light three times. I failed, and I was eliminated!" said the chief instructor, Wu Tong, while throwing out his ID card to the bearded man."Just a little bit." The bearded man gritted his teeth, shook his head and walked out of the red circle.
"Next, Luo Feng." Chief Instructor Wu Tong said.
Luo Feng and Yang Wu fist-bumped each other once, and then walked directly into the red circle.
Standing in the red circle, with the muzzle of the test machine in front facing him, Luo Feng took a deep breath. Before entering the martial arts gym, he often practiced his body skills at home. This dodge has always been his strongest point: "Before the college entrance examination, I usually got hit 50 to 55 times in 60 seconds. But now that my physical fitness has improved, my reactions are faster, and I have no problem passing the test."
"" Chief instructor Wu Tong finished speaking and pressed the red button.
"Du~~du~~"
The muzzle of the neural response testing machine accelerated rapidly and quickly rotated to an extremely fast speed. Then dozens of muzzles in the muzzle burst out with red light almost instantly, and rubber bullets were fired immediately.
"Huh?" Luo Feng stared intently, quickly calculating the position in his mind. His whole body was like a flexible cat, constantly dodging forward, backward, left and right, dodging rubber bullets again and again. Of course, there are also some that are too fast and cannot be avoided, so they can only take a 'shot'.
Luo Feng was dodging quickly, while the warriors watching from the side started talking.
"This young man is good. His reaction speed seems to be even better."
"It's very fast, his body skills are very good, and his foundation is very solid. You see, his feet are like the pads of a cat's paws. He does not lose his center of gravity every time he moves his body skills, and can change direction instantly. This kind of body skills... If you are not a genius, you will not be able to achieve such a solid foundation without ten years of hard work."
The warriors present were all amazed.
A warrior's physical fitness can be improved through practice. However, body skills, sword skills, etc. all depend on experience. It doesn't mean that the stronger the body, the higher the skill.
"Woo~~" After pressing the button, the neural response testing machine decelerated and stopped, and a large series of numbers appeared on the screen.
"Within 60 seconds, you were hit 28 times without touching the red light. Excellent!" Chief Instructor Wu Tong smiled. "That's right, Luo Feng, congratulations. As long as you wait for the official document to be issued and your information to be entered into the citizen's identity information, you will be a quasi-warrior!" After passing the assessment, a formal certificate will usually be issued within seven days and recorded in the citizen's identity information.
Luo Feng clenched his right fist hard: "We finally succeeded!"
I finally became a quasi-warrior!
"Luo Feng, there will be a warrior's actual combat assessment on August 1st. In the morning, we will gather at the Extreme Club Hall. Under the leadership of the instructor, we will go with other quasi-warriors to hunt monsters outside the urban area of ​​the human base! When you pass the actual combat assessment, you will be a real warrior." Instructor 'Jiang Nian' said with a smile.
